title: I made an online co-op puzzle platformer using agentic engineering
author: No-Dragonfruit-675
selftext:
Working on this game called STUFFED. It's 2-8 players. 

You and your friends are plush toys escaping a toy factory and if one of you pop the whole team starts over.

**Development**

I believe this is the future of game development.

I first wrote a very modular framework for game development prior to claude code's release back in late 2024.

The framework is designed to split up functionality by separating data from logic and prioritizing composition. I recently decided to take the project off the shelf and see what I could do with it and this is the result.

Composition and meaningful structure in your project give agents context and help prevent drift which slows you down.

This was done in about 2 days of work while working on other projects. I have 2 other games currently baking.



Would love and welcome all feedback!

[https://stuffed.studiod8.com](https://stuffed.studiod8.com)
